assets.prompt:
Create ONE complete, independent cinematic narrative painting, landscape 16:9 about 1672x941 pixels. A single continuous believable scene, realistic hand-painted military concept art with subtle brush texture, restrained 1990s espionage atmosphere. Main gesture/figures/important prop concentrated LEFT 55 percent; RIGHT 45 percent continues the same environment with calm lower-contrast space for later narration. NO text, subtitles, lettering, logos, captions, HUD, panels, borders, comic page, collage or inset. This is an explicitly ALTERNATE CQC simulation story using original Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake 1990 MSX2 source identity, never a claim that these narrative events happened in official canon. Anatomically plausible humans and period objects. References are evidence, NOT a request to copy their pixel art or embedded words into the painting. Do not render any letters from references. Preserve the actual reference body palette and broad environment cues. Invent no modern exoskeleton, gas mask, cyber optics, glowing magic or fancy uniform ornaments. Zanzibar Land is inland fictional Central Asia, continental temperate tall grasses, not an island or beach; no ocean or palms. Jungle Evil = Predator in original1990 MSX2, a human ambush mercenary. Original small sprite shows deep green fatigues and a dark ordinary gun; face, exact garments and weapon model are NOT established. Keep unknown features occluded as directed. He hides in grass, not optical magic. Read this exact existing alternate narrative ONLY for context, do NOT print its words: La tige pliée — Hautes herbes de Zanzibar. Jungle Evil redresse une tige écrasée près de sa cache. Le camouflage de sa tenue ne servira à rien si la végétation raconte trop clairement le trajet qu’il vient d’emprunter.

Il connaît ce terrain assez bien pour y disparaître. Cette connaissance commence pourtant à ressembler à une habitude: son corps choisit parfois le meilleur appui avant que son regard vérifie qu’il l’est encore.
COMPOSITION AND MOMENT TO PAINT: Tight close-up at grass level inside dense ochre seed grasses, a crouched human mercenary at LEFT delicately straightens one crushed long stem between thumb and forefinger. Only his one olive-green cloth sleeve, hand, second supporting hand and a little green shoulder are visible; FACE, hair, headwear, legs and equipment are completely hidden behind grass, NOT a portrait. A slim ordinary dark rifle section lies low among the grass beside him and is mostly occluded. Clear bent stem focal point. Dawn muted warm greens and ochre. Right half continuous dense grass with faint continental hill backdrop, no new character.
